_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Test Scheduling Report
summary: The Test Scheduling Report provides pre-test information to inform the technical supervisor of a scheduled major test.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Test Scheduling Report provides pre-test information.
3.2 The report informs the technical supervisor of a scheduled major test.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
7.2 This DID is applicable to test programs other than those conducted at National Ranges.
7.3 This DID supersedes DI-T-1909.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Media.
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Scheduling Report specific media shall be a teletype message. The message shall be sent to the technical supervisor within (24) hours after a test is definitely scheduled.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Scheduling Report format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Scheduling Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Scheduled data and hour of test
Comparison of test objectives, hardware, and description to the project office test plan, with an explanation of all deviations.
Comparison of test objectives, hardware and description to the detailed test plan with an explanation of all deviations.
children.content: Intended "quick fixes", improvisions and deviations in either test objectives, hardware or description shall be explained in detail.
